goal: Enforces semantic consistency between attribute values by restricting admissible values based on the value of another attribute
description: Values of an attribute must be compatible with values of another attribute.
statement: In the BiodiversityObservation entity, when the detectionStatus attribute has the values {notDetected}, the breedingEvidence attribute of BiodiversityObservation entity must not contain values from the set {courtship, nesting, chicks}.
supportingMaterials: HELEADE use case, IST revision (Section 6.2); illustrative requirement
